handoffs.message: Ready for review. PR #229 merged into dev as 6addd055 after CI gates passed. Commit dcd8d01e adds scripts/lovable/strict_publish_audit.py, focused tests, and generated support/evidence/lsp-final-audit/strict-publish-audit.{json,md}. Local verification: py_compile clean; Lovable audit pytest set 27 passed; git diff --check clean. Live hosted audit against https://pantheon-dev.lovable.app/management is a truthful FAIL: LSP-002 and LSP-003 passed, LSP-004 found 84 forbidden seed/mock signals.
Review approved: strict publish audit script, tests, and evidence packet all meet acceptance criteria. Truthful FAIL evidence recorded against live deployment. Returning to Codex2 for finalization.
